pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Replit Core costs $20/month on annual billing or $25/month monthly… Core includes $20 in monthly credits… In February 2026, Replit rolled out its biggest pricing overhaul yet - a new Pro plan, a revamped Core, and the retirement of the old Teams tier."

has_free_tier.note: Sources refer to a free tier ("4x compute power versus the free tier").

plans.name: Core
plans.quota: $20 in monthly AI credits, up to 5 collaborators

nl.tagline: Online ontwikkelomgeving met een AI-agent die apps bouwt en host
nl.description: Replit is een ontwikkelomgeving in de browser waar de Replit Agent apps voor je bouwt, test en online zet. Hosting, databases en samenwerken zitten erin. Sinds februari 2026 kent Replit een nieuwe planstructuur met Core en Pro.
bestFor: Apps bouwen én hosten op één plek
notFor: Teams die volledig op eigen infrastructuur willen draaien
limitations: Verbruik boven de inbegrepen credits wordt apart afgerekend

en.tagline: Online dev environment with an AI agent that builds and hosts apps
en.description: Replit is a browser-based development environment where Replit Agent builds, tests and deploys apps for you, with hosting, databases and collaboration built in. Since February 2026 Replit uses a new plan structure with Core and Pro.
bestFor: Building and hosting apps in one place
Learning to code with AI help
notFor: Teams that must run entirely on their own infrastructure
limitations: Usage beyond included credits is billed separately
